jobs.location: United States - Remote
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart’s enterprise business is at an inflection point. Retailers and CPG brands are navigating a rapidly shifting grocery landscape—and the demand for Instacart’s ecommerce, fulfillment, in-store, retail media, AI and data solutions has never been greater. We’re hiring a Director of B2B Enterprise Product Marketing to be the strategic engine behind how we bring this platform to market. This role sits at the intersection of product, commercial, and marketing, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how Instacart powers the future of grocery.

What you’ll cook up in your first year

- A unified go-to-market strategy for the enterprise platform that is adopted by Product, BD, and Customer Success as the definitive playbook—giving each team clear positioning, messaging, and campaign tools to win deals and grow adoption.

- A differentiated market presence for Instacart’s enterprise solutions, built through compelling thought leadership narratives, multi-channel campaigns, and industry authority that make Instacart the go-to name for grocery retailers evaluating ecommerce and fulfillment partners.

- A high-performing, respected product marketing team—four direct reports who are well-integrated into the commercial organization, operating with clarity on priorities, and recognized as indispensable contributors to Instacart’s B2B success.

- A sales pipeline meaningfully moved by marketing, with awareness and lead-gen campaigns across events, paid media, content, PR, webinars, and partnerships that are measurably converting interest into conversations.

- A global market entry foundation, with regional strategies developed and tested that support Instacart Enterprise’s expansion beyond existing markets.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

You are a builder and a storyteller—someone who can translate complex enterprise technology into messaging that resonates with grocery executives, while also rolling up your sleeves to get campaigns out the door. You thrive in ambiguity, love working cross-functionally, and bring a bias toward outcomes over activity.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

- 10+ years of B2B marketing experience at a SaaS company, with demonstrated ownership of product marketing across multiple product lines

- People management experience, with a track record of growing and developing marketing teams

- Proven ability to build and execute full-scale, multi-channel B2B campaigns that drive both awareness and qualified lead generation

- Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to distill complex technical topics into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences including C-suite

- Experience developing effective positioning, messaging frameworks, and thought leadership strategies that translate into sales enablement materials

- Ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority

- Comfortable operating independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities

- High proficiency with Google Slides and comfort with basic marketing analytics

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience marketing to retailers or grocery audiences, with an understanding of their unique business challenges and buying cycles

- Familiarity marketing to a range of company sizes, from large enterprises to SMBs

- Background in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

- Technical proficiency that enables effective partnership with product and engineering teams

About the Team

Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. - Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.

- Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

- Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

- Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.

- Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

- Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.

- Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).

- Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.

- Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).

- Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.

- Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.

- Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.

- Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

Instacart’s product and technology partnerships — spanning logistics, retail technology, and enterprise products — are a core lever for how we build and grow. It needs a senior leader who can set the multi-year vision, personally own the most consequential relationships, and shape how Instacart decides what to build versus buy versus partner. Without this person, we risk reactive partnership decisions, misalignment between partnerships and product strategy, and missed first-mover opportunities in markets where speed matters. - Instacart has a clear, credible multi-year partnership strategy across Logistics, Retail Technology, and Enterprise — one that leadership has bought into and that's actively shaping which product bets we pursue versus partner for.

- At least one first-of-a-kind deal — in a new product area or international market — has gone from concept to signed to launched, with a playbook behind it that the team can repeat.

- The partnerships team is operating at a higher level — Senior Managers and Managers have clearer ownership, stronger frameworks for deal evaluation and partner performance, and a leader who’s actively developing them for what comes next.

- Product and Engineering leadership treat this person as a genuine strategic partner — not just a deal-closer — because they’ve visibly influenced roadmap decisions and brought external perspective into how we build.

- Instacart’s most critical external partners — at the C-suite and executive level — have a named senior relationship owner who shows up with authority, earns trust, and surfaces the opportunities that matter most to the business.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples  (Minimum Qualifications)

- 15+ years of experience in business development, product partnerships, or strategic alliances in technology or closely adjacent industries, with end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder deals from sourcing through launch.

- Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing partnerships teams, including managing managers and structuring a function for scale.

- Proven track record of closing complex, non-standard technology or strategic partnership agreements — including first-of-a-kind deals — with C-suite or executive-level counterparts.

- Experience serving as a true strategic partner to Product and Engineering: influencing roadmap and build-buy-partner decisions, not just executing alongside them.

- Strong financial and analytical skills, including business case development to evaluate partnership economics and communicate ROI to senior leadership.

- Comfortable operating without a roadmap — brings clarity and direction to a team even when the path forward isn’t obvious.

- Experience with software and/or hardware partnerships across retail, grocery, in-store technology, e-commerce, loyalty, POS, or adjacent ecosystems.

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, enabling Instacart and its retailer partners to deliver highly relevant, effective advertising experiences at scale.
